free_tier.stated: A free NAT VPS with a shared IPv4 and a dedicated IPv6: 'NAT VPS is almost similar to other VPS but uses the NAT method so that a single IPv4 can be shared to many VPS and then assigns a different port for each user.' The site states 'Full SSH access', 'Unmetered Bandwidth — All data centers provide Unlimited bandwidth' and 'Shared IPv4 — VPS comes with Shared IPv4 and Dedicated IPv6'. No CPU, RAM or disk figure is published on any page read.

chaining: Same composition as Hax: an IPv6-only root box needs an IPv4 front, and the daily renewal is the part that cannot be automated without an external scheduler and stored credentials.

registration requires a Telegram numeric ID, obtained by messaging @HaxTG_bot with /getid

limits_note: The instance is reclaimed unless renewed daily, so the server is only always-on while a human logs in every day; a missed weekend loses the machine and its data.
binding_note: the machine expires on a short clock that only a human can reset, so it cannot be an always-on node

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account is the identity: the register form as served has exactly one input, 'Telegram ID', marked required, and the page instructs 'Send private message to @HaxTG_bot, type this command: /getid'. No email, no card, no hold and no document. A Telegram account in practice needs a phone number, which is why this is recorded as any-phone rather than email; the form itself does not ask for a phone number.
